tasks.title: Preserve prototype and pin shell baseline
tasks.description: Verify archive branch/tag/bundle, fetch-only remotes, pinned upstream lock, and baseline evidence.
tasks.details: Validate archive refs and bundle SHA; verify v5.0.23 tests, release build, server/WebView startup, and record remaining manual playback checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Repository refs, bundle verification, cargo test/build, isolated process/network smoke.

tasks.title: Implement strict extension manifests and loader
tasks.description: Add safe mode, independent enablement, debug directories/CDP, origin-gated deterministic injection, and separate WebView2 profile.
tasks.details: Reject remote/absolute/traversal paths, duplicates, unsupported schemas, missing/oversized files; isolate extension failures.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust unit tests plus enabled/disabled startup smoke.

tasks.title: Implement shared resilient native storage
tasks.description: Create generic versioned JSON storage with validation, serialized access, atomic Windows replacement, backup, and corruption preservation.
tasks.details: Use fixed %LOCALAPPDATA%\JStremio\data paths, capped reads, same-directory UUID temps, flush/sync, known-good .bak.

tasks.title: Implement Reviews and Timestamp Notes native models
tasks.description: Add strict schemas, validation, timestamps/revisions, stable review keys, UUID note IDs, duration snapshots, and CRUD stores.
tasks.details: Reviews: rating 1-5 and 5000-char text. Notes: required text, ms bounds, multiple notes per timestamp, out-of-range support.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust boundary, CRUD, persistence, duplicate, and restart tests.

tasks.title: Implement origin-gated fixed IPC
tasks.description: Connect approved WebView origins to Reviews and Timestamp Notes operations with correlation, caps, and safe errors.
tasks.details: No arbitrary paths, commands, network, or generic MPV. Add fixed openDataFolder actions.

tasks.title: Build the TypeScript runtime and compatibility adapter
tasks.description: Add frozen idempotent window.JStremio, bridge, media targets, playback snapshots, restricted seek/pause, lifecycle, DOM adapter, overlay/dialog hosts, and diagnostics.
tasks.details: Parse MPV events without wrapping onCoreEvent; centralize upstream DOM heuristics and one reconciler.
tasks.testStrategy: Vitest runtime, media, message, validation, lifecycle, and fixture tests.

tasks.title: Implement Local Reviews extension
tasks.description: Add one navigation item, management overlay, current-player button, accessible editor, canonical navigation, CRUD refresh, and error states.
tasks.details: Shadow DOM UI; Reviews must never alter playback.

tasks.title: Implement Timestamp Notes capture and management
tasks.description: Add navigation/search/grouped overlay, capture-before-pause workflow, -5/+5/reset, conditional resume, editor, CRUD, and out-of-range warnings.
tasks.details: Disable for live, missing time/duration, external playback, or unstable video ID with an explanation.

tasks.title: Implement timeline markers and clustering
tasks.description: Mount a pointer-transparent marker layer on the current seek slider with resize/fullscreen/remount handling, tooltips, popovers, direct seek, edit/delete, and 10px clustering.
tasks.details: Absolute timestamps remain authoritative; hide out-of-range markers and never cross media targets.
tasks.testStrategy: Marker math, clustering, click seek, remount, keyboard, and normal seek tests.

tasks.title: Harden privacy and failure isolation
tasks.description: Exercise missing core/channel/time, live playback, DOM churn, bundle exceptions, IPC timeout, corrupt stores, and out-of-range timestamps.
tasks.details: Each failure disables only its feature; private text never enters logs or network.
tasks.testStrategy: Failure-injection, network inspection, and safe-mode tests.

tasks.title: Add checks, fixtures, and real-shell regression workflow
tasks.description: Provide check/run-dev/test-e2e scripts, deterministic legal media fixtures, WebView2/CDP opt-in checks, and enabled/disabled regression records.
tasks.details: Verify same official endpoint/server handoff/player path and unchanged volume/mute/audio/subtitle/stream behavior.
tasks.testStrategy: Cargo/TypeScript/Playwright/release build plus manual audible-output checklist.

tasks.title: Package and document JStremio
tasks.description: Produce separate portable JStremio output and optional unsigned installer metadata with separate identity/profile/data/updater behavior.
tasks.details: Document first login, backup/import, safe mode, rollback, update, SmartScreen, GPL, clean-profile validation, and hashes.
tasks.testStrategy: Portable clean-profile smoke, restart persistence, safe mode, and official-install coexistence checks.

tasks.title: Fix current Stremio player control discovery
tasks.description: Adapt player-button and seek-slider discovery to the official Web UI's focusable div controls and layered non-semantic Slider DOM.
tasks.details: Replace button-only and ARIA-slider-only assumptions in the centralized compatibility adapter; preserve semantic fallbacks, avoid complete CSS-module hashes, copy integration classes from focusable controls, and use realistic current-upstream fixtures.
tasks.testStrategy: TypeScript compatibility tests, Playwright control/remount/marker/seek flows, full repository check, and portable manifest verification.

tasks.title: Polish player timestamp marker UX and metadata
tasks.description: Make the body-owned player controls hover-reveal reliably, synchronize markers/popovers with Stremio control visibility, add outside/Escape/close dismissal, and persist optional marker color and rating.
tasks.details: Keep the dock discoverable while controls are immersed without blocking the seek bar. Hide and close marker UI when the official overlay hides. Add an accessible close button and click-outside behavior. Extend timestamp-note schema-v1 records with validated optional color and 1-5 rating fields using backward-compatible serde defaults, and expose both in create/edit, markers, popovers, and management UI.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust validation/backward-compatibility/CRUD tests; TypeScript and Playwright hover, hidden-overlay, outside click, close/Escape, color/rating persistence and rendering; real WebView2/MPV smoke; full package integrity audit.

tasks.title: Match extension controls to official Stremio navigation styling
tasks.description: Make the immersed player dock fully transparent until hovered, center timestamp-note close controls, and restyle Reviews/Timestamp Notes navigation buttons to match official icon color, dimensions, and hover-only labels.
tasks.details: Preserve the body-owned hover hot zone with zero idle opacity and pointer interaction. Replace font-glyph close alignment with centered SVG/grid styling. Derive custom navigation button and icon classes/geometry from the official navigation template, remove always-visible labels and black button chrome, and retain accessible names/tooltips.
tasks.testStrategy: Compatibility unit tests, Playwright idle/hover and navigation geometry/color/tooltip checks, current official WebView2 live-DOM smoke, full repository gate, and portable integrity audit.

tasks.title: Isolate dialog typing and resync paused fullscreen markers
tasks.description: Prevent extension dialog keyboard input from reaching Stremio global shortcuts and refresh timestamp-marker viewport bounds during paused fullscreen/native window resize transitions.
tasks.details: Stop composed keyboard events at the extension Shadow DOM boundary after target handling. Observe window, Fullscreen API, and VisualViewport resize signals and schedule marker-bound synchronization across layout frames. Add Playwright regressions for both Reviews and Timestamp Notes typing plus a paused position-only timeline move.
tasks.testStrategy: TypeScript tests, Playwright keyboard propagation and paused-resize marker alignment, full repository gate, real WebView2/MPV smoke, portable integrity audit.

tasks.title: Polish dense timestamp marker interaction
tasks.description: Shrink timeline marker visuals, add hover/focus scaling, and show a cursor-positioned picker for clustered nearby timestamp notes.
tasks.details: Keep the marker hit area usable while reducing the visible marker footprint. Open clustered-note popovers on hover/focus without stealing focus, position the picker near the cursor, and preserve direct click-to-seek behavior plus edit/delete actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Playwright marker size, hover scale, cluster picker, outside dismissal, seek, and package audit.

tasks.title: Fix timestamp marker popout placement and sticky interaction
tasks.description: Keep marker popouts inside the visible window, make click-opened popouts stay while users select timestamps, and show details popouts for single markers too.
tasks.details: Clamp marker popouts against the viewport using fixed positioning, prefer above-marker placement, prevent hover updates from replacing sticky click popouts, and expose the same note details picker for single-note markers on hover.
tasks.testStrategy: Playwright viewport-clamp, sticky click, single-marker hover popout, full check, real WebView2/MPV smoke, package audit.

tasks.title: Pin timestamp popovers and add frame thumbnails
tasks.description: Keep click-opened timestamp popovers anchored in place and add optional local frame screenshot capture with thumbnails in timestamp management and marker previews.
tasks.details: Add an opt-in screenshot control to timestamp create/edit UI; capture the current native MPV frame through a narrow validated bridge operation; store image files locally without embedding large data in JSON; persist a safe thumbnail reference; render thumbnails in management cards and marker hover/click popovers; ensure pinned popovers no longer track pointer or get replaced; add cleanup and validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust storage/IPC tests, TypeScript unit coverage, Playwright marker popover and thumbnail tests, full check script, release portable package.
